$comment: §5/§5.2/Appendix R — the per-tick GAMEPLAY payload: the seat's current fogged knowledge, one byte string handed unchanged to play_step and (at view cadence) to the socket. Cap: MaxViewFrameBytes (32768), backed by the element caps below with deterministic selection BEFORE encoding, so the encoded payload is always valid JSON. Fog provenance per field: the §5.2 observation matrix is normative; nothing here is ever sourced from the omniscient SimEvent stream. Guard paths (world.alive_teams, self.hp_frac, …) read this payload through the shared evaluator registry (§5.1).
title: play_view

epoch.$comment: u64: the seat's ACTIVE call epoch ("0" = no declaration)

hp_frac.$comment: hp over max hp for this seat's team (handicaps and perks applied)

lives.$comment: omit in br (elimination: alive is the fact)

intent.$comment: the seat's own STANDING order (the folded, finished Intent that the body executes); omit before the first standing order

zone.$comment: mode br only (schema tests pin per-mode presence, §5.1): public zone facts, already on every frame

next.$comment: the announced next rectangle; omit between announcements

dps.$comment: the ACTIVE phase's outside-rect damage per second; 0 while no damage phase is live

objectives.$comment: mode ctf only: capture objectives (flag state per team)

tracks.$comment: tracked allies and enemies under the seat's own fog; ≤ 32 (the roster, never truncated). The duo partner's row is a DELIBERATE GRANT (§5.2): live position+aim, always fresh while both live — and it ends exactly at the partner's death (stale-track handling thereafter).

aim_brads.$comment: omit when aim is not readable

hp.$comment: omit when unknown (unknown hp scores 0 for ptWeakened, §5.2)

fresh_tick.$comment: the tick this track was last confirmed

bounty.$comment: fog-derived from the visible veteran marker with track freshness; omit when false/unseen/stale (§5.2)

items.$comment: item memory, ≤ 32 entries keeping the freshest then the nearest

aggressors.$comment: victim-private hit feedback against SELF, window 120 ticks, ≤ 16 most recent first: shooter identity only if visible at that moment, else anonymous-with-direction (§5.2)

kill_feed.$comment: public by design (deliberate grant, §5.2): killer TEAM and victim seat, tick-stamped, window 240 ticks, ≤ 32 most recent first; carries no killer seat and no location

shouts.$comment: heard shouts, the same fogged, jittered, anonymous-slot-letter facts a Sprite client reads (§4.3/§5.2): one per live shouter, ≤ 32

slot_letter.$comment: anonymous slot letter; a departed shouter reads ?

pos.$comment: jittered by the same helper as the bubble

hazards.$comment: Appendix R.1, normatively: every capped list truncates by the shared urgency predicate (covering hazards first, then ticks-to-blast ascending / recency descending, then distance, then stable event id)

grenades.$comment: visible airborne grenades, ≤ 8: predicted blast center + ticks to blast are the safety inputs; pos is display metadata

blast_cues.$comment: anonymous POST-BLAST evidence (history for plays, never an evasion input, R.1), ≤ 4 retained, 24-tick lifetime

sprays.$comment: tagged union rows, ≤ 8 retained: visible_cone (attacker fog-visible; covers_self is the ENGINE's complete predicate, walls and barriers included — never a geometry reconstruction) | anonymous_impact (victim-known jittered trace, 48-tick window)
